result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Shows transitive package dependencies that can be removed

USAGE:
    willow [PROJECT|SOLUTION] [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    willow Project.csproj
    willow Project.csproj -e Foo -e Bar
    willow Project.csproj --tfm net462
    willow Project.csproj --tfm net462 --strict
    willow Solution.sln
    willow Solution.sln -e Foo -e Bar
    willow Solution.sln --tfm net462
    willow Solution.sln --tfm net462 --strict

ARGUMENTS:
    [PROJECT|SOLUTION]    The project or solution you want to analyze

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                  Prints help information                         
    -t, --tfm <MONIKER>         The target framework moniker to analyze         
    -e, --exclude <PACKAGE>     One or more packages to exclude                 
        --skip <PROJECT>        One or more project references to exclude       
    -s, --strict                Returns exit code 0 only if no conflicts were   
                                found                                           
        --no-prerelease         Verifies that all package references are not    
                                pre-releases                                    
        --vulnerable            Cross-references packages with the OSV.dev      
                                vulnerability database and tags rows with       
                                severity                                        
        --internal <PATTERN>    One or more prefixes/patterns that classify a   
                                package as internal (e.g. Acme or Acme.*). When 
                                set, results are grouped into internal (fixable 
                                at source) and external (must wait or override) 

COMMANDS:
    version          Prints the Willow version number                   
    why <PACKAGE>    Shows every dependency path that leads to a package

    [PROJECT|SOLUTION]    The project or solution to analyze                    

OPTIONS:

    -t, --tfm <MONIKER>     The target framework moniker to analyze  
        --skip <PROJECT>    One or more project references to exclude
